name: Ant’s Auto Repair and Tow
brandNarrative:
At Ant's Auto Repair and Tow on North Broad Street, Anthony has built something rare in the auto repair world: a shop where customers actually get called over to the lift and shown exactly what's wrong — and what isn't. When Angel Odd came in after a competing shop quoted her $1,800 for suspension work she didn't need, Anthony put her Jeep Grand Cherokee on the lift, walked her through every component, and told her plainly that her shocks and struts were fine and that the other shop had tried to take advantage of her. He fixed her headlights, brake lights, and electrical issues — and charged her honestly. That's not a sales pitch. That's what the reviews describe, again and again.

What separates Ant's from every other shop in Philadelphia is the combination of radical transparency and around-the-clock availability. When Koomi's car started throwing loud engine noises on a Sunday — the day most mechanics won't answer the phone — Ant's took the car in same-day, diagnosed an exhaust leak within hours, and had it fully repaired and ready for pickup by Monday. Communication happened via text the whole time. No chasing anyone down. No vague timelines. Kemi Martins showed up on a Friday with a mystery noise and left with extra repairs done at no additional charge. This shop operates like it genuinely cannot stand leaving a car worse than it found it.

The culture runs deeper than just Anthony. Luis, one of the technicians, diagnosed an oil consumption issue and resolved it in under two hours — keeping the customer informed at every step of the process. Lissette Alvarez described dropping her car off in the evening and picking it up fixed the next day. The reviews don't describe a transactional shop; they describe a place where customers leave feeling relieved, respected, and confident. That's the real product Ant's Auto Repair and Tow is selling — and a 4.7 rating across 105 reviews suggests Philadelphia has noticed.
ownerStory:
Anthony — the mechanic customers keep coming back to by name — didn't build his reputation through advertising. He built it by doing something most shops stopped doing long ago: treating every customer like someone worth being honest with. He's been described by reviewers as 'one of the smartest, most realistic, and most honest mechanics' they've ever dealt with, and the pattern across reviews suggests that's not a fluke. When a woman came in after being misled by another shop, Anthony didn't just fix her car — he took her under the lift, pointed at every component, and explained the truth. He called out the exploitation directly. That's not just mechanical skill; that's integrity with a socket wrench in hand.

Running a 24-hour operation at 2750 N Broad Street, Anthony and his team — including technician Luis — have carved out a niche that Philadelphia desperately needs: a shop that's actually there when your car breaks down on a Sunday, that texts you updates instead of going silent, and that fixes things without padding the bill. The business reflects Anthony's character: direct, dependable, and completely unbothered by cutting corners because cutting corners was never part of the plan.

reviews.text:
I have to give the biggest shoutout to Anthony, because this man is truly one of the smartest, most realistic, and most honest mechanics I’ve ever dealt with in my life.
I brought my 2002 Jeep Grand Cherokee Laredo in after another shop tried to play me. They gave me an $1,800 estimate JUST for suspension, talking about I needed brand‑new shocks and struts and a whole list of parts my car didn’t even need. Something told me to get a second opinion, and thank God I did.
From the moment I pulled up, Anthony was different.
He put my Jeep on the lift, called me over, and actually showed me everything — what was wrong, what wasn’t wrong, and what the other shop flat-out lied about. He told me straight up:
“Your shocks and struts are more than fine. They tried to rip you off because you’re a woman.”
And he was right.
Not only did he fix the headlights I originally came for, he also fixed all my brake lights, handled my electrical issues, and basically corrected everything he saw that needed attention. He didn’t upsell me, didn’t exaggerate, didn’t pressure me — he just did the work honestly and explained every step.
Even the man assisting him was on point.
Their teamwork, professionalism, and customer service were 10 stars across the board.
I left that shop feeling relieved, respected, and confident in my car again.
If you want a mechanic you can TRUST, someone who won’t lie, cheat, or take advantage of you, especially as a woman go to Anthony. He’s the real deal.
reviews.author: Angel Odd

reviews.text: Car started making loud engine noises over the weekend all of a sudden, it was a Sunday and I needed it to get checked and fixed by the following Saturday. Luckily, Ant's is one of the few places open on that day and he took care of it by taking the car in the day of, diagnosing the issue (exhaust leak) within a few hours, then promised to have it fixed within two days latest as he got the parts. All is said and done, the car's exhaust leak got fixed even earlier than that and was ready to pick up on Monday. I was charged a very reasonable price, and for the quick service, constant communication via text, no hassle, and availability at a time most mechanics wouldn't be, it was a great experience all around.
reviews.author: Koomi

reviews.text: Great mechanic! My car started making a scary noise out of nowhere on Friday. Only place that was able to help me and so quickly. Even fixed other things on my car for no extra charge, would 10/10 recommend!!
reviews.author: Kemi Martins

reviews.text: Anthony, the mechanic, is great! He is very kind, clear and direct.. service is fast and quality care! I took my car to him yesterday evening and it was done today! I am very happy with the service and time frame!! Prices are reasonable. You won’t regret letting Anthony work on your car.. he makes every customer priority! Rest assured your car is in good hands here! Will definitely be going back in the future!
reviews.author: Lissette Alvarez

reviews.text: My vehicle was running out of oil every other day. Luis diagnosed my vehicle and fixed it with in 2 hours ,I love that he kept me informed every step of the way !! He deserves a raise. 10/10 I would Highly recommend
reviews.author: Danielle Jazz

stats.label: Hours Open Every Day of the Week

faq.question: Are you actually open 24 hours, every day of the week?
faq.answer: Yes — Ant's Auto Repair and Tow operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including Sundays and holidays. Multiple customers have specifically praised the shop for being available when every other mechanic was closed.

faq.question: How do I know I won't get overcharged or upsold on parts I don't need?
faq.answer: Anthony's approach is to put your car on the lift and show you exactly what's wrong — and what isn't. Several customers have come in after receiving inflated estimates elsewhere, and Anthony has corrected the record on the spot, declining to charge for work that wasn't necessary.

faq.question: How fast can you turn my car around?
faq.answer: Turnaround is fast. Customers have had cars diagnosed within a few hours of drop-off, with repairs completed the same day or within 24-48 hours depending on parts availability. Evening drop-offs have been ready the following day.

faq.question: Will you keep me updated while my car is being worked on?
faq.answer: Yes — the team communicates throughout the process, including via text. Customers specifically highlight the consistent updates and the fact that they never had to chase anyone down for information.

faq.question: Do you offer towing services as well as repairs?
faq.answer: Yes. Ant's Auto Repair and Tow offers towing services alongside all mechanical repair work, available around the clock at (267) 774-6361.

faq.question: What if I'm worried about being taken advantage of as a first-time customer?
faq.answer: Multiple reviewers — including women who came in after being misquoted at other shops — have specifically called out Anthony's honesty and respect for every customer. He explains the work, shows you the evidence, and charges you for what your car actually needs.

brandColors.note: Deep navy anchors the trust, credibility, and no-nonsense honesty that defines Anthony's reputation. Amber-gold reflects the 24/7 availability, urgency, and the warmth customers describe when they say they left feeling relieved and respected — not just repaired. The pairing reads as serious and dependable without being cold.
